content_md:
The simpler the protocol the easier it is to spread. In games a very simple protocol is: have two sticks, one big one small. Hit small stick with big stick. Some people will hit others will catch the small stick. Build whatever rules you want on top of this. 


https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gillidanda
